choose.when:
insert into wf_deploy_form (deploy_id, form_id, form_key, node_key, form_name, node_name, content, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values
(#{form.deployId}, #{form.formId}, #{form.formKey}, #{form.nodeKey}, #{form.formName}, #{form.nodeName}, #{form.content}, #{form.createBy}, current_timestamp, '0')
choose.otherwise: insert into wf_deploy_form (deploy_id, form_id, form_key, node_key, form_name, node_name, content, create_by, create_time, del_flag) select '', 0, '', '', '', '', '{}', '', current_timestamp, '0' where 1 = 0

mapper.select: select deploy_id, form_id, form_key, node_key, form_name, node_name, content, create_by, create_time, del_flag from wf_deploy_form where deploy_id = #{deploymentId} and del_flag = '0' order by node_key, form_key

select count(*) from wf_deploy_form where del_flag = '0'
and form_id in
#{formId}
and 1 = 0
